changes: Added a deadzone between the arrows on the maneuver node.
Fixed a crash when removing a maneuver via the flight info menu
Add new PBR system (currently commented out) to switch to

PBR system changes: The new PBR system applies a lot of fixes to the old PBR code which affect the planets, distant planets, and space vessels. It is currently commented out as we will slowly switch to it as tweaks are made. To switch to the new PBR system, search for the following shader comment "New PBR system below" in these files:
DistantSphere.frag
Planet.frag
MeshFragCommon.glsl Things that have been fixed when moving to the new PBR system:
Added ambient lighting
Switch "roughness * 2" to "roughness" in Lo lighting for the planet shine onto the mesh.
Fixed ao to only be applied on the ambient term instead of the Lo (sun or planet light ray) term as well.
Fixed light color to be applied to the specular term as well.
Still no sun attenuation
Moved mesh vert and frag shaders into their own folder and refactored code
Added reflection code and useful global shader variables to be used later
Set the PBR reflect color to black for the mean time Setting the PBR reflect color to black prevents it from being bloomed too much in the new PBR system.
Added placeholder sounds for rcs and engine on Apollo and Gemini Testing vehicles.
Added support for basic 3d audio.
Added SetMasterVolume() function to GameAudio.cs

Refactored Gauge Instance bindings to move from two individual uints for bit packing, to a single uint4. This provides 128 bits of information available per instance, significantly extending the data that can be packed for gauge rendering per instance.
Added support for up to 16 characters draw at once with the label system using SDF fonts, including support for spaces.
Refactor of digit roller system. Completely removed the old one and upgraded all of it and all bindings. Now animation is fully prepared on CPU saving a lot of per pixel calculation.
Fixed numerous bugs with digit rollers, such as shortest path being taken for some roller directions.
Fixed planet meshes collapsing as a result of mismatching vertex and index buffers when tabbing to them from a celestial rendering a different mesh LOD.
Simplified the PlanetRenderer vertex input.
Removed reliance on terrain mesh LOD state when updating descriptor sets. It turns out the impact of updating the set each frame is negligible for just one update.
changed default flare intensity to 0.3
compute shader sunbloom blur - minor efficiency pass (pre-pass still an option for some settings)
removed initial blur implemented there
lightened the sampling for transmittance - can increase if moved to pre-pass (64 look-ups to 12 per pixel)
added "toggle bloom" settings for both bloom passes to game settings -- more work can be done to reduce some setup/teardown there, but this at least removes them from the render passes
[WIP] commiting some of the initial setup for the kawase blurs to replace current blur passes for improved efficiency
a lens flare visibility eclipse change
Switch shadowmaps from 32-bit to 16-bit to save some bandwidth on effects sampling shadowmap, notably godrays
Small speedup in godrays and shadow sampling by using textureLod instead of texture
Tweak godray bias setting
Apply cloud color to 2d clouds
yet another eclipse edit - finally fully squished the bug with uv offsets that I've been hunting
you can use the debug flare/orbs/7th option in debug flare options to see the base sample points
further reduced sampling for transmittance to 6 samples (down from 12)
Major upgrade to the attitude control panel, exposing a whole slew of new settings, operating modes, and pointing targets. All buttons include tooltips, so do a mouse hover if there is any confusion.
NOTE: the burn computer buttons are temporarily unavailable - these will be resurrected in the next commit along with improvements to the auto-burn flow.
Fixed major error where vehicles in freefall could fail to be taken off-rails while inside the physics radius of a celestial body.
Added and explicit attitude tracking target enumeration to the flight computer that provides a higher-level interface between the pilot and the computer.
Added direct manual thruster commands which use maximum pulse widths as a higher-authority alternative to the fine-control minimum pulse widths.
Added a keybinding to toggle between high and low manual thrust settings.
Improved attitude maneuvers by choosing slew directions that don't unnecessarily create roll error.
Combined attitude target and attitude rate target since they are mutually exclusive.
Combined attitude mode and burn mode into the same enum type.
Made vehicle reference frame names more explicit since they deviate slightly from their associated general reference frames.
Move some deserialization around so it's more difficult to accidentally not initialize the flight computer properly.
Added top-level celestial info and orbit line entries for the currenly-followed vehicle to the view menu to replace the quick buttons on the old panel.
Added VehicleRegion to the serialization data.
Removed duplicate BURN navball button.
Fixed an error in the QuaternionEx.ToShortestArc() function.
a touch of optimization for the atmo LUT portion of sunbloom shader
added #define to switch between modes of avg transmittance AND max cosZen
moved to single LUT lookup based on max cosZen - which is then used to set the transmittance
removal of some unnecessary calcs based on earlier optimizations
elimination of depth test - we want the transmittance along the horizon regardless of depthtest success
removed unused backup fragment shader that I accidentally committed some time ago
Fixed orphan maneuvers and gizmos when deleting earlier maneuver nodes.
Remove UniTask NuGet package from project. Not used, shouldn't have been there.

Fixed issue where worker task for maneuver plan update was updating the Orbit points on the current orbit. naughty naughty, we are supposed to cache this stuff to the next frame, which was creating race issues between drawing and worker thread on crappy old CPUs.
Added first pass of additional gauge UI editing windows.
Made non-focused maneuver nodes selectable and highlight when moused over.
Made it so you can add another maneuver node without having to close the old one.
Fixed missing Transfer planner and flightplan buttons by adding them back into the UI for now.
Added first pass of new button type for use with Navigation Computer canvas.
Changed the maneuver node gizmo to use cones. The goal will be to move the cones along their axes to help give better visual feedback for the change of the rate of change based on mouse movement.
kawase blur implementation for swift blur calculations to fake blur
uses the dual down-sample/up-sample for blur for the first 3 passes down to 1/16th size
holds at 1/16th size for subsequent passes - helps resolve temporal artifacts due to sampling at very little cost in speed

[WIP] There is no current threshold kawase implementation, nor does it currently replace our bloom+threshold bloom passes. To examine the current kawase, I recommend toggling off blooms in game settings - then enabling kawase in its debug menu - the current settings are NOT recommended, and the two scalars should implement a lerp (should add to 1) for consistency but, have fun!.
Add clouds editor GUI
Simplify how isotropic and anisotropic scattering are handled in atmosphere raymarching function
Added a "refill" console command to refill vehicle consumables (just propellant at the moment).
Add a GetVelocityEgo() function to the camera so we can compute doppler shift. NOTE: we use the followed object's velocity instead of the camera's velocity since that isn't tracked currently.
Modified the object labels to use EGO velocity rather than orbital velocity.

Changed IOrbiting to split out Position, Velocity and Reference Frame methods into separate interfaces. this allows Astronomical to no longer have a Parent reference. Instead Celestials and Vehicles have Parent references via the IParent interface. This reduces a large amount of null checking on Parent throughout the code. Parent is no longer nullable.

Fixed NaN when attempting to solve invalid closest approach mean anomaly in the closest approach solver. We catch the NaN in the SolveKepler method to avoid the error in Math.Sign call and we suppress the NaN warnings in the closest approach solver code
Fixed the orbit lines getting eaten by aberrant weather and planet shadows. They now render after the in-world post processing.
fixed gauss bloom wrapping - which - while fun - is incorrect
big refactor - moved all blooms under one "head" for easier manipulation
edit defaults / use debug in Overall Bloom Renderer which includes
kawase (k) global (g) and thresholded (t) options
gaussian (b) vert/hor split global and thresholded options
blooms render in this order: bt->kt->bg->kg (but you really shouldn't use all four)
game setting options toggle on/off kawase blooms
turn these off if you're going to use the checkboxes in the overall bloom debug menu
tests on my machine indicate a x8 reduction in time to blur when using kawase rather than gauss (although less savings for smaller gauss kernels obviously)

moved all blooms under one framework "Overall Bloom Renderer" - easier to debug the general pipeline out of here and everything is in one place / controlled by the same parameters (both gauss and kawase are driven by the same parameters - which are not exactly the same in both)
Multi-window fix for the console on scaled displays (like 2x Retina scale)
Added third pass of the flight computer gauge buttons. Disabled in XML for now, but this will replace the IMGUI flight computer buttons. Nearly complete.
Refactored how buttons are referenced in XML to provide extra options directly.
Reworked how gauge data is packed, allowing an additional 128 bit of data, so 256 bits per instance in total. This allows the standardization of labels, colors, and styles.
Add passing terminal interface parsing errors to the console window.
Stop planet shine when vessel is on planet surface

Attenuate planet shine The planet shine was applying to vessels while they were on the surface, causing a weird and unrealistic look. This change increases the planet shine linearly as the vessel goes further away from the planet surface.
Move reflectColor() to MeshFragCommon.glsl
Add debug button in physics menu to teleport vessel to Mars
Migrated Flight Computer to the new button system completely.
Added ability to toggle all gauge canvases on/off via the "View" menu option.
bug fix that left gaussian blurs on in certain situations
basically those should stay off from now on - unless we just want a high quality blur test or ground tooth
bug fix so that limited threshold bloom to values that should actually be thresholded
the downsampling is weighted, and then the threshold was applied. Fixed to correctly thresholding those computations, so only pixels > luminance threshold are bloomed
based on the fixes above, changed some default settings.
blur threshold size of 50 (which is roughly around a 2 pixel offset blur at all upscaled steps).
blur threshold to 6.0
modified some sun and flare settings to match adjustments
Added rounding option to GaugeBox in XML. This allows rounding of color boxes drawn on gauge canvases. Implemented on the Nav Computer and Attitude panels.
Added right click option to disable (close) a Gauge Canvas. Can be then renabled via the View menu.

Fix duplicated shaderData update in OnFrame causing every odd frame index to be skipped, causing incomplete cloud and godray subpixels resulting in lines/artifacts depending on resolution and upscaling setting
Null checks for atmosphere and cloud UI, for when those features are disabled
Added coloring for foreground color on buttons.
Added Propellant Mass Gauge that displays the total propellant mass on the craft.
Fixed incorrect clamping of digit rollers would cause wrong magnitude changes to occur with multi-unit rollers.

Added polymorphic handling of procedural modifiers in the Terrain XML section. Modifiers can be defined with the "Modifier" XML element and the loader will figure out from the modifier Type attribute which type to parse it as and will automatically parse the correct parameters it expects.

Starting the process of removing the backreferences to Vehicle from ManeuverPlan to avoid the cross-thread interaction that currently exists and improve the clarity of data flow for the flight computer as a part of burn execution.
Removed backreference to FlightPlan from PatchedConic.
Removed separate patch color and derive color from the inner Orbit to consolidate this info.

As a side effect, removed the code that prevented you from removing a maneuver orbit period to before the vehicle's current time (but it still respects the patch time). This didn't seem necesary to me but we can enforce this again if necessary, will just require passing a small amount of context.
split of final upsample round from previous upsamples in kawase blur implementation
upsample rounds use a lerp that is currently set to use only the blur from upscaling (lerp with a weight of 0% on the original) -- setting in debug
final round uses a separate scalar 1.0 * original + 0.5 blur -- setting in debug with separate scalars
global blur can be scaled using a lerp
new *sane* defaults have been added to the above settings
Removed IOrbiting backreference from FlightPlan. This revealed some dubious uses of the current position for futures patches in DrawLines - probably could use a closer look.
Added Audio Settings tab to settings menu.
Added Master Volume Slider. Volume sliders map to a non-linear scale.
